basic_details.job_title: Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 TGT, Mess Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sainik School Chittorgarh is recruiting candidates for 5 vacancies, comprising TGT (Mathematics), TGT (Science), TGT (English), TGT (Computer Science) and Mess Manager posts on a regular basis. Eligible applicants must send their offline applications by post to The Principal, Sainik School Chittorgarh, Bhilwara Road, Rajasthan on or before 7 November 2026, starting from 17 October 2026. Qualifications and age limits vary according to the post as specified in the official notification. The notified pay scale is Pay Matrix Level 7 (Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400) for TGT posts and Pay Matrix Level 5

application_fee.details: The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of Sainik School Chittorgarh, payable at Chittorgarh.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates must enclose self-attested photocopies of the following documents with their application form: Birth Certificate Aadhaar Card Discharge Book (if Ex Serviceman) Caste Certificate (if SC/ST/OBC candidate) Marriage Certificate (if applicable) Class X Mark Sheet All educational documents mentioned in application form Experience Certificates mentioned in application form Certificates of courses completed mentioned in application form Details mentioned in application form regarding Proficiency in Games/Co-Curricular activities Details mentioned in application form regarding Service Training attended, if any NCC Certificate A/B/C (if any) mentioned in application form Application Fee Demand Draft in favour of Sainik School Chittorgarh, payable at Chittorgarh

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a Written Test, Class Demonstration, Proficiency/Skill Test, and Interview. Call letters are issued to eligible shortlisted candidates by email or through the School website. Candidates who secure minimum qualifying marks in the Written Exam are called for Class Demonstration, Proficiency/Skill Test, and Interview. For Academic Posts (Para 3.1 to 3.4): General Knowledge (15 Marks), General English (15 Marks), Basic Maths (10 Marks), Subject Test of appropriate level (60 Marks). Total: 100 Marks. For Mess Manager Post (Para 3.5): General Knowledge (05 Marks), General English (10 Marks), Basic Maths (10 Marks), Subject Test of appropriate level (25 Marks). Total: 50 Marks.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit applications for Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application forms at Sainik School Chittorgarh is 7 November 2026.

faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies have been advertised across TGT and Mess Manager posts.

faq.answer: The application fee for UR and OBC candidates is Rs. 500/- payable through a Demand Draft.
